hadith:
Holding Steadfast - Narrated by 'Abdullah bin 'Amr -  Volume 9, Book 92, Number 410 

I heard the Prophet saying, "Allah will not deprive you of knowledge after he has given it to you, but it will be taken away through the death of the religious learned men with their knowledge. Then there will remain ignorant people who, when consulted, will give verdicts according to their opinions whereby they will mislead others and go astray."
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Waali - الْوَالِي - The Governor

The name Al Waali signifies Allah's role as the ultimate authority and protector over all creation. It indicates His sovereignty and ability to manage and govern the affairs of the universe. The origin of this name can be traced to Arabic roots, where it emphasizes the loving and guiding relationship Allah has with His creation, showcasing His mercy and power.
verse:
An-Nazi'at - Those who drag forth - 79:45

Your duty is only to warn whoever is in awe of it.
